name: Marikina City Open 2018

venue.name: Cinco Hermanos Clubhouse
venue.address: 17 Aquarius, Cinco Hermanos Subdivision, Industrial Valley Complex, Marikina City, Philippines

information:
**All registrants are required to read the COMPETITOR INFORMATION tab**. Payment is needed to complete your registration and secure your slots for the competition. Check out the **Payment Details tab** for the process of payment.


Registration fee is 300php good for 2 events (any event of your choice). 50php shall be added per extra event registered.  Payment is needed before registrations via the WCA website is approved. Only the first 90 paid registrations will be accepted and allowed to compete on event day.
